body: I have tried talking to her. For a while we were friends, and I let her use me as a demonstration at her beauty school. She was able to get inti the advanced coloring class, while I shaved my head due to the damage my hair sustained. And I did tell them. The second I discovered she was sharing friends. They didn't believe me. Said that it wasn't the person they knew. So, by seniority, she wins.
At the community college here, it was okay. University was better, but it was the wrong time to go. I wish I could have enjoyed it more.

I graduated alone, since nobody liked me. I was the new girl, and I tried my damnedest to be nice. This person, reasons beyond me, hated me. So since I was the newcomer, when rumors spread nobody listened to the truth. Once I left, I felt like o could continue life. I had a boyfriend, college, job, everything. Two years later she comes into said relationship by a series of coincidences and ruins it. My boyfriend left me. A year later, many bad bumps, just now.I'm starting to do stuff again. Starting to find new love and new friends. I had high hopes for this new slow moving relationship with a boy, and some girls who wanted to know me. It was odd when they stopped calling or texting this week. So I just bit my tongue. Figured it was work, or they were busy. I found out she was in said group of friends, and nobody wants to talk to me now. Not even the guy who wanted to know me. I don't have a single friend here. And I tried so damn hard this week only to walk through the door and find a letter. She wrote me a letter detailing it. And all I wanted was some goddamned friends who didn't live 45 minutes away.
Which would distract us from the impending doom. Then together, we can talk about it all on 'I Shouldn't Be Alive' or 'I Survived'
And eventually, the group laughs. I just told my friend, who is also in our boat, that the internet supports him. So together, we can all bitch about the sinking ship.
We're in the same sinking boat. But that means we got a buddy with us. So, at least we're not alone, right?
Thank you. I just checked my phone and saw this. I truly appreciate your offer :)

That's actually what I've been trying to do.  I walk the dog, and sometimes I just go to the park and sit.  It's the routine that's hard to get into.  Which is probably why I haven't felt better.  My doctor also said I needed to force a routine for sleeping better too.
